title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Megacap AI break, miners melt up. SpaceX’s capex blowout crushed semis while gold’s +4.14% surge and Fed hike odds defined a defensive reallocation under record index levels.

INDICES — VIX 15.8, down 3.33% in futures. DIA +0.44%, SPY -0.20%, RSP -0.23%, IJH -0.62%, IWM -0.64%, QQQ -0.90%, SOXX -2.12%. Large > small by 0.44pp. Gold +4.14% led cross-asset; oil -0.78%. Neither SPY nor QQQ below 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 1.2x, QQQ 0.8x — index breadth diverging as money fled Nasdaq into Dow. GLD 2.4x with price up = accumulation. XLV 1.7x on defensive bid; XLK 0.8x confirms AI distribution.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +1.27%, XLB Materials +1.23%, XLY Discretionary +0.30%, XLF Financials +0.21%, XLRE Real Estate +0.07%, XLI Industrials -0.03%, XLP Staples -0.05%, XLK Technology -0.53%, XLU Utilities -1.02%, XLC Comms -1.04%, XLE Energy -2.07%. Top: GDX +7.39%, SILJ +6.28%. Bottom: MSOS -7.13%, WGMI -4.78%. Money exiting AI hardware into gold miners and healthcare; energy dumped on Hormuz hopes. Rotation label: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.42 elevated, QQQ 1.04; skew positive. GEX flip 778 vs spot — below flip amplifies downside. VIX 15.8 under 20-day 17.2 = complacency despite protection demand. MOVE 73.6 elevated, bond vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold +4.14% with dollar -0.25% and 10Y yield down — classic real-rate collapse. SpaceX’s Nvidia-only call split AI chain: NVDA +3.4%, AMD -7%.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 65.9. Movers: AEM +9.85% FCF strength, PAAS +7.41% undervaluation, UBER -5.29% on 3.3x volume. Watch GDX +7.39% (2.5x vol, real breakout), LLY +4.86% (2.8x vol, defensive bid), ANET +3.57% (2.8x vol, AI divergence from AMD).
